decision.rationale: Scientific approval is limited to executing Package 160 as an independent exact-load C4 reference calculation, not acceptance of R6 or certification of solver results. Examination of the supplied complete input deck and Package 147 reference confirms that Step 1 preserves the reference loading and Step 2 changes the prescribed endpoint to uy=0.0018603125442191958 mm, using a monotonic 0.0000600000000000 mm increment over 0.012 s. The frozen UEL matches its prescribed SHA-256. All 13 embedded evidence items match their declared SHA-256 hashes when their original line-ending conventions are preserved. The supplied qualification receipt reports three Abaqus datachecks with Exit 0; underlying remote .dat evidence and current scheduler status still require independent execution-gate verification. The serial 1-CPU, 16-GB, 8-hour configuration and once-only submission policy are appropriate. The proposed computation is scientifically justified because the existing reference frames do not contain the required exact-load state. Execution remains conditional on authenticated reviewer attestation, genuine technical qualification and canonical submission accounting. After execution, independently verify the converged exact-load endpoint, reaction force, RAW total energy and applicable physical conditions before assessing R6. No interpolation, inferred physical acceptance or automatic retry is authorized. The supplied conversation URL and fallback message ID are placeholders, not independently verified provenance.
